Apri Firma Elettronica. Se hai CIE abbin:
Open Electronic Signature. Choose a paired card or Sign with an unpaired CIE. Select a document or drop it into the upload area; you can prepare it before connecting the reader. One file is accepted at a time. The application checks its contents: PAdES is available for supported PDFs; CAdES creates a P7M. Choose the format and press Continue.

Place the selected CIE on the reader. Paired cards require the last four PIN digits; unpaired cards require all eight. If the protected store is unavailable, you can explicitly choose the full PIN; no alternative authentication is tried automatically. Press Sign and choose where to save. An existing filename requires system confirmation before replacement. Cancelling the save dialog clears the PIN without authenticating the card.

Signing makes one attempt and clears the PIN field. The result is checked cryptographically before saving. An existing file is replaced only after successful signing and verification; it remains intact on failure. Successfully signed confirms that the file was saved. Expand the details to distinguish integrity, trust and revocation. Indeterminate revocation does not mean a valid certificate. Back keeps your choices but clears the PIN; Cancel and Finish return to document selection. Pair the card again after changing its PIN.
Apri Verifica Firma e scegli un PDF/P7M:
Open Verify Signature and select or drop a PDF/P7M. Verification starts immediately, without another button, reader, card or PIN. You may cancel or select another document while waiting; superseded results are discarded. A running check may take a moment to finish; it does not operate on the CIE.

Each signer has a card for signature integrity, certificate and revocation. An indeterminate result does not mean not revoked; a connection problem does not mean an invalid signature. The time claimed by the signer differs from a verified timestamp. Open Signer Details for chains, timestamps and historical results. Historical and Long-Term Validity shows the separate DSS analysis; signers from the two engines are not matched by list position alone. This application does not certify the legal qualification of a signature.

Verify Again refreshes checks on the original file. Choose Another Document opens the file picker; Finish returns to selection. A readable P7M offers Extract Document after analysis even if its signature or certificate is invalid. Choose a new destination: existing files are not overwritten. Extraction uses the analyzed copy, preserves embedded bytes and does not open the document automatically. If the original changed, verify it again. Nested containers are extracted one level at a time.

Collega un lettore contactless compatibi:
Connect a compatible contactless reader and place your CIE on it. On Windows install the manufacturer's driver if required. The application detects the reader and card automatically, without asking for a PIN or changing the current page. If another application is using the card, wait for it to finish. If several cards are available, choose the correct one.

On Home, press Pair CIE. On Windows, if the website access component is missing, the app first requests Windows administrator permission to install and enable it. After activation, enter the eight-digit PIN once. Card data is verified and both partial-PIN signing and website access are prepared. The first four digits remain in macOS Keychain or Windows Credential Manager; verified holder details and the public certificate are stored separately. The full PIN is not saved. The website access component must be active. If it is missing, signing pairing remains available and Home explains how to finish preparation without another PIN.

Previously paired CIE cards remain usable for signing. Complete Pairing explicitly updates configuration with the full PIN; the last four digits are not used silently. After confirmation, Remove CIE removes this application's pairing and website configuration, even without the card. The original application's configurations stay separate.

With PAdES selected, enable Add Visible Signature and press Continue. Open Preview and Customize to view the PDF locally. Choose a page, drag the rectangle or use the arrow controls, and adjust its size. Customize it with a PNG/JPEG or choose Restore Default Text Signature. The name comes from the verified paired-card data; without those data a placeholder is shown. The actual holder's name is always read directly from the CIE while signing, after the PIN and without a second authentication, even with a custom image.

For a paired CIE, the custom image is copied into this application's store and reused only for that card. A previous global image may be imported explicitly, keeping the original. Going back keeps the page and position; changing the document cancels the preview. Graphics for unpaired cards are an additional feature and are not associated with a card. Confirming the preview does not sign: press Continue to reach the PIN step.

Graphics are optional and do not replace the cryptographic signature. Supported limits are 10 MiB and 16 megapixels for images, 256 MiB for documents, and PDFs without passwords. New visible-signature tests with a real CIE remain to be performed on macOS and Windows.

L’accesso con carta fisica e lettore (li:
Website access with a physical card and reader (level 3) is prepared when pairing from Home. It requires CryptoTokenKit on macOS or the smart card component on Windows. On Windows, the app automatically offers installation with administrator permission before the pairing PIN. If you decline, you can cancel or explicitly continue with signing only. The application distinguishes signing pairing, certificate publication, component availability and system identity observation. None of these alone confirms website login.

For an already paired CIE, Enable Website Access installs and activates the Windows component with administrator permission; keep the CIE on the reader. Complete Website Access reuses verified public data already saved and does not request another PIN. If the system needs to read the card again, remove and replace it. Then open the website in your browser, choose Sign in with CIE and the physical card/reader option. Select the certificate if prompted and enter the PIN yourself in the system dialog. Website access requires all eight PIN digits on both macOS and Windows, even for a paired CIE.

In Settings, Advanced Website Access Tests contains the local component test and technical recovery tools. These are not routine steps before every login. Login to the official CIE portal using Safari succeeded with an earlier build; the unified workflow, other websites/browsers and Windows login require separate tests. No website consent or PIN attempt is performed automatically. Real Change PIN and Unblock Card tests remain deferred.

Se il lettore non compare, verifica cavo:
If the reader is missing, check its cable, driver and smart card service availability; prevent another application or virtual machine from occupying the device. If the card changes, wait for automatic recognition before signing. For network errors, check the connection and proxy in Settings: without reliable revocation responses, the result remains indeterminate.

Support provides FAQs, official CIE contacts and references for this independent project. In Settings you can enable diagnostics limited to outcomes and timings, view the report and export it without automatic transmission. The proxy is used for ordinary verification and historical CRLs; credentials remain in the current session only.

This guide describes the application for macOS and Windows. Linux and distribution installers remain to be completed. The new website access components are experimental and require the testing described in section 9. Pairings are local to this application: they are not migrated from the original application and do not enable website access on their own. This application does not replace the published macOS application and does not certify the legal qualification of a signature.

Select a P7M in Electronic Signature. If its signatures are intact and its content is supported, Add a Signature is offered; otherwise the application explains why co-signing is unavailable.

When co-signing, you may choose CAdES Co-sign or extract the original content for a new signature using Create New Signature. Co-signing adds a signature to the same content. Existing signatures are retained and checked against the result. A full PIN is required for an unpaired card; a paired card requests only the last four digits. The shared backend sends one authentication attempt to the card. Co-signing never overwrites the original P7M or automatically retries a failed PIN.
